command: timeout 5 sh -c 'fsize=$(stat -c%s -- "$1") || exit 1; off="$2"; if [ "$off" -lt 0 ]; then start=$(( fsize + off )); else start=$off; fi; if [ "$start" -lt 0 ]; then start=0; fi; if [ "$start" -gt "$fsize" ]; then start=$fsize; fi; bs="$3"; skip=$(( start / bs )); printf '"'"'%d\n%d\n'"'"' "$fsize" "$start"; dd if="$1" bs="$bs" skip="$skip" count=2' -- /home/readme.txt -5 5
